title: A note for a new flatmate
instructions: 原创模拟情境，非官方试题；这是独立分科短测，不是40题完整试卷。开始前不看正文、原音、词表或答案。先独立完成8题并保存原始答案，提交后再核对依据。难度是编写目标，尚未经真实考生标定。
passage:
Hi Leo,
Welcome to our flat. Your room is the small room on the left. The blue key is for the front door. The red key is for your room. We eat dinner at seven, but on Friday we eat at eight. There is milk in the fridge for everyone. Please write your name on your other food. We wash clothes on Sunday. The machine is in the bathroom. Please keep your bike in the garden. Bikes cannot stay in the hall. I work in a shop in the morning. If you need help before lunch, please send me a text. My phone is quiet at work, so do not call.
Anna

options: The large room on the right
The room next to the garden
The small room on the left
answers: The small room on the left
questions.evidence: Your room is the small room on the left.
questions.explanation: small 和 on the left 都是房间信息。

questions.prompt: 前门用什么颜色的钥匙？写一个英文单词。
questions.evidence: The blue key is for the front door.
questions.explanation: red 是房间钥匙，前门是 blue。

questions.evidence: We eat dinner at seven, but on Friday we eat at eight.
questions.explanation: Friday 是七点惯例的例外。

questions.prompt: 哪一样食物供大家共用？
questions.evidence: There is milk in the fridge for everyone.
questions.explanation: 只有牛奶明确是大家共用；其他食物要署名。

questions.prompt: 洗衣日是星期几？写原文英文。
questions.explanation: 机器位置是 bathroom，洗衣日是 Sunday。

questions.evidence: The machine is in the bathroom.
questions.explanation: machine 指前句所说洗衣服的机器。

questions.prompt: 自行车应停在什么地方？写一个英文单词。
questions.evidence: Please keep your bike in the garden.
questions.explanation: hall 是禁止停放处，garden 才是指定位置。

questions.prompt: 午饭前需要帮助，Leo 应怎样联系 Anna？
questions.evidence: If you need help before lunch, please send me a text.
questions.explanation: 工作时手机静音，因此应发短信而不是打电话。
